description: Verify a VSL Settlement Receipt. Runs every check and reports all of them, including the ones that passed, rather than stopping at the first failure. Requires no network and no account: the issuer key document is supplied by the caller. Use this to decide whether a Receipt you were sent is trustworthy before acting on it.

chain.description: Optional. Earlier Receipts you hold. When given, previous_hash is followed back to the head and every Receipt on the way runs the full procedure; an empty array is still a chain, with nothing held. Never fetched: only what you pass is used.

governance_receipt.description: Optional. The governance Receipt, if held.

issuer_keys.description: The issuer's published key document, as JSON. Either the key-set shape with a `keys` array, or a did:web DID document.

party_keys.description: Optional. A party key document, or an array of them (one per party; links in one chain can have different parties), to verify triggers. A key_id two documents claim is refused. Omitting it skips the trigger check, which is honest when the keys are not held; the result says so.

receipt.description: The Settlement Receipt document to verify.

name: verify_receipt
